title: Maintenance response
text: Log the issue with its timestamp, property, and photos. A staff member reviews urgent requests before contacting a vendor.

title: Rent payment records
text: Record the due date, amount due, amount received, and payment date. Flag any mismatch for a human to review.

title: Tenant screening privacy
text: Request consent before screening. Keep screening reports restricted to authorized staff and do not include report details in outbound messages.

title: Lease documents
text: Store a versioned copy of a signed lease and record the parties and signature date. Refer contract interpretation questions to a qualified reviewer.
